xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4830: Phone app: APNs and FCM delivery of sealed push in services/connect

plan.title: Phone app: APNs and FCM delivery of sealed push in services/connect
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: About 30 distinct files_scope paths, but one subsystem (services/connect) plus its unit/integration tests and one doc; 13 of the paths are test files. W-CON3 is already the epic PAN-4823 child-issue unit. A sibling split (push/ library vs directory integration) would ship a library nothing calls, and registration without delivery is a frame the directory accepts but cannot act on, so neither half has an independently verifiable acceptance criterion; epic AC-3 needs both.

narratives.Problem: The overdeck.ai directory (services/connect) refuses push, push-register and push-unregister as bad_frame. Phones cannot register an APNs/FCM token and machines cannot get a sealed notification to a closed phone app (epic PAN-4823 D-5, W-CON3).
narratives.Proposal: Phones register their token on their clients row; a machine push is validated (known client, registration, 30 per account per UTC minute) by a pure reducer, delivered by the glue to APNs (deterministic quantized ES256 token, placeholder alert + sealed blob) or FCM HTTP v1 (service-account OAuth, data-only sealed blob) with one 2 s retry, and answered with push-result after a second pure step that clears dead tokens. Storage moves to directory-store.ts first to keep files under 600 lines.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No machine-side native push provider, sealing or push-result handling (PAN-4843)
- No phone-side registration, NSE or FCM handler (PAN-4838, PAN-4840)
- No Live Activity pushes or push-activity frame (PAN-4839)
- No production secrets, Apple/Firebase setup or deploy (PAN-4841; deploy is operator-only)
- No user-facing Mintlify pages or ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md edits (PAN-4842)
- No change to CONNECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION or any packages/contracts type
- No persistent delivery queue and no retries beyond one 2 s retry
- No push token, sealed payload, JWT, access token or key in any log line
- No node: imports or new dependencies in services/connect
- No committed private keys or PEM fixtures

autoDecisions.summary: Rate limit is a fixed UTC-minute counter in DirectoryState persisted as meta row push_window
autoDecisions.rationale: An in-memory counter resets when the Durable Object hibernates (~10 s idle); the Cloudflare RateLimit binding is a Worker binding and the decision lives in the DO reducer. Persisting keeps it deterministic and testable with an injected clock.

autoDecisions.summary: APNs JWT uses quantized iat (45-min windows) and deterministic @noble/curves p256 signing with a module-level cache
autoDecisions.rationale: Every account DO signs its own token; randomized WebCrypto ECDSA would change the token per DO and risk 429 TooManyProviderTokenUpdates. t3code's Worker relay uses this exact scheme; @noble/curves is already a dependency.

autoDecisions.summary: The .p8 scalar is read via WebCrypto importKey(pkcs8, extractable) + exportKey(jwk).d, with a DER-walk fallback (CP-1)
autoDecisions.rationale: services/connect must use Web APIs only (no node:crypto); the Miniflare test proves which path workerd supports.

autoDecisions.summary: Per-fetch timeout 2,000 ms, one retry after 2 s on the send only, FCM OAuth exchange not retried
autoDecisions.rationale: Worst case 8 s stays under the machine's 10 s push-result wait (epic W-MAC3).

autoDecisions.summary: A dead token answers push-result no_registration; other failures and unconfigured providers answer delivery_failed
autoDecisions.rationale: The contract has four errors; a dead token means the phone dropped notifications, which W-MAC3 treats as not operator-facing.
Mirrors the existing turn flag so the operator can see W-REL1 secrets took effect without revealing values.

autoDecisions.summary: push-register whose platform differs from the phone's hello-client platform is refused with bad_frame; apsEnvironment is accepted only for ios and defaults to production
autoDecisions.rationale: Contract says apsEnvironment is iOS-only; a mismatched platform can only be an app bug and would route a token to the wrong provider.

autoDecisions.summary: Push tokens must match /^[0-9A-Za-z:_.-]{1,4096}$/ and are percent-encoded in the APNs URL
autoDecisions.rationale: The APNs token is placed in the URL path; refusing /, ?, % and spaces closes path injection.

autoDecisions.summary: Storage code moves to directory-store.ts before push code lands
autoDecisions.rationale: directory.ts is 588 lines and the epic forbids source files over 600 lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Only docs/CONNECT-SERVICE.md (plus .dev.vars.example and the wrangler.jsonc comment) is updated here
autoDecisions.rationale: User-facing Mintlify pages and ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md belong to W-DOC (PAN-4842) per the epic.

Sign deterministic APNs provider tokens and send the placeholder alert

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only the new push/apns.ts and its own test file; no other item edits them.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (D-9, D-10). push/apns.ts: constants APNS_TOPIC=ai.overdeck.app, PLACEHOLDER_TITLE=Overdeck, PLACEHOLDER_BODY="Something needs you", APNS_TOKEN_WINDOW_SECONDS=2700, APNS_DEAD_REASONS. class ApnsTokenCache.get(config, nowMs): iat = floor(nowSec/2700)*2700; reuse cached JWT for the same iat; else read the P-256 scalar via crypto.subtle importKey(pkcs8, extractable) + exportKey(jwk).d (fallback: DER bytes after 02 01 01 04 20), sign signingInput({alg:ES256,kid},{iss:teamId,iat}) with p256.sign from @noble/curves/nist.js (RFC 6979, compact). export sharedApnsTokens. apnsBody(sealed, collapseId) returns exactly the FR-4 object. sendApns(req, {config, fetch, now, tokens}) posts to api.sandbox.push.apple.com or api.push.apple.com /3/device/<encodeURIComponent(token)> with the FR-4 headers; maps 200 delivered, 410 gone, 400 with dead reason gone, >=500 retryable apns_<status>, throw retryable apns_network, key error failed bad_key, else failed apns_<status>. SendResult is imported from push/config.ts. Keys in tests are generated at runtime.

items.title: Given a runtime-generated P-256 key, when ApnsTokenCache.get runs, then the JWT header is {alg:"ES256",kid} with claims {iss,iat} and its signature verifies with crypto.subtle.verify

Given a window start T0, when get runs at T0+44 min and T0+46 min, then it returns the same JWT at 44 min and a different JWT with iat T0+2700 at 46 min; two separate caches at one time return byte-identical JWTs

Given a stub fetch, when sendApns sends a high-urgency push to a sandbox registration, then the URL is https://api.sandbox.push.apple.com/3/device/<token>, apns-priority is 10, apns-topic is ai.overdeck.app, and the parsed body toEqual exactly apnsBody(sealed, collapseId)

Given APNs answers 410, or 400 {"reason":"BadDeviceToken"}, when sendApns runs, then it returns gone; given 400 {"reason":"PayloadTooLarge"} it returns failed apns_400; given 503 it returns retryable apns_503
Exchange the FCM service-account token and send the data-only message

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only the new push/fcm.ts and its own test file; no other item edits them.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 (D-11). push/fcm.ts: FCM_TOKEN_URL=https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token, FCM_SCOPE, FCM_TOKEN_EARLY_REFRESH_MS=300_000. class FcmTokenCache.get(config, fetchFn, nowMs) signs the RS256 assertion {iss:clientEmail, scope, aud:FCM_TOKEN_URL, iat, exp:iat+3600} with WebCrypto RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5/SHA-256, posts form-encoded grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer via fetchWithTimeout, caches access_token until expiresAt-5min; failures fcm_oauth_<status>, fcm_oauth_network, fcm_oauth_bad_response, bad_key; drop(clientEmail). export sharedFcmTokens. fcmBody(token, sealed, urgency, collapseId) returns exactly the FR-6 object (HIGH/NORMAL, ttl 3600s, collapse_key, no notification key). sendFcm posts to https://fcm.googleapis.com/v1/projects/<projectId>/messages:send; 200 delivered, 404 or details[].errorCode UNREGISTERED gone, 401 drop token + failed fcm_401, >=500 retryable fcm_<status>, throw retryable fcm_network, else failed fcm_<status>.

items.title: Given a runtime-generated RSA key, when the token exchange runs, then the request is form-encoded with grant_type jwt-bearer and the assertion claims equal exactly {iss, scope, aud, iat, exp: iat+3600} and verify with the public key
Given a cached access token, when sendFcm runs again before expires_in minus 5 minutes, then no token request is made; at expires_in minus 4 minutes a new token request is made
Given a stub fetch, when sendFcm sends a normal-urgency push, then the parsed body toEqual exactly fcmBody(token, sealed, "normal", collapseId) with android.priority NORMAL and no notification key
Given FCM answers 404 or a 400 body with errorCode UNREGISTERED, when sendFcm runs, then it returns gone; given 401 it returns failed fcm_401 and the next send fetches a new access token
Choose the provider, retry once after 2 s and return a PushOutcome

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6 (D-12, D-13). push/deliver.ts: PUSH_RETRY_DELAY_MS=2_000; deliverPush(req {registration, sealed, urgency, collapseId}, opts {config, fetch, now, sleep?, apnsTokens?, fcmTokens?}): Promise<PushOutcome>. iOS uses config.apns and sendApns, Android config.fcm and sendFcm; a null provider returns not_configured with no fetch. retryable => await sleep(2000) and retry once; a second retryable => failed with its detail. sleep defaults to setTimeout. Tests use vi.useFakeTimers.

items.title: Given apns: null in the config, when deliverPush runs for an iOS registration, then it returns not_configured and the fetch stub records zero calls

narrative.Action: PRD WI-9 (D-1, D-2, D-3, D-8, D-13). DirectoryState gains pushWindow {minute, count}|null (EMPTY_DIRECTORY null); DirectoryEffect gains put-push-window and deliver-push {requestId, clientId, registration, sealed, urgency, collapseId}; directory-state case push returns pushAnswer(state, f, ctx, self). push-state.ts pushAnswer: unknown to => push-result unknown_client; no registration => no_registration; minute=floor(now/60000), count>=PUSH_RATE_PER_MINUTE => rate_limited; else window+1, put-push-window and deliver-push; never reads ctx.online/onlineClients. reducePushOutcome: delivered => ok:true; gone => clear push only if row.push.token === used token (put-client-push null) and no_registration; failed => delivery_failed log failed_<detail>; not_configured => delivery_failed. directory-store.ts persists meta push_window and loads it. directory.ts executes put-push-window (order 0) and deliver-push (order 2: await deliverPush with parsePushConfig(this.env), this.deps.fetch, this.deps.now, then applyPushOutcome which reduces against the current this.state).
